title: Make Day Setup confirmation explicit
objective: Prevent runstate skeleton keys, Drop, ledger, or other unrelated writes from satisfying the Day Setup gate. Persist day_setup_confirmed only from a successful POST /day-setup for the current planning day and require an explicit setup confirmation before write paths proceed.

diagnosis.root_cause: Two compounding defects: (a) /plan-inputs echoed any non-empty day_setup keys from a materialised skeleton runstate, and frontend projectDaySetup derived confirmed: Object.keys(wire).length > 0 (the any-key check), so a skeleton note (gather / Drop / ledger writes) read back as user-confirmed; (b) no server-side gate existed on the external write paths, so an unconfirmed day could still commit.
diagnosis.observed_failure: The observed run skipped Day Setup because schedulable was empty and work_allotment_minutes was null — the skeleton echo satisfied the frontend confirmation heuristic and the wizard landed past the setup step.
diagnosis.fix: Explicit runstate key day_setup_confirmed (default False) written True ONLY by a successful POST /day-setup for the dated note; /plan-inputs exposes the flag; frontend confirmation is flag-driven, never key-presence-driven; /commit?mode=live and /runtime-actions apply/undo fail closed (409, actionable) when the flag is missing.

acceptance_criteria_met: An empty or skeleton runstate cannot satisfy Day Setup confirmation: is_day_setup_confirmed is strict-boolean on day_setup_confirmed; a fresh note, a /gather materialised skeleton, a Drop write, a commit-ledger persist, a billed-ledger persist, a sequence side-effect write (overlap_grants/pinned_rows/fingerprint), and a pre-change note WITHOUT the key all read False (covered by TestConfirmationSource).

Drop/ledger/other runstate writes cannot satisfy the Day Setup gate: only the /day-setup route writes updates[DAY_SETUP_CONFIRMED_KEY] = True; every other runstate write (gather, dropped, commit_ledger, billed_calls, sequence keys) leaves the key False or absent, and the frontend projection ignores echoed keys entirely.

Successful day setup POST is the only source of confirmation, scoped to the current planning day: POST /day-setup returns day_setup_confirmed: True and persists it into today's dated note only; a day_setup_confirmed: True note on another date does not confirm today (test_confirmation_scoped_to_planning_day).

Write paths fail closed with actionable status when setup is missing: /commit?mode=live and /runtime-actions apply/undo return 409 with 'Day Setup not confirmed for <date> — confirm Day Setup before <action>'; the live-commit fail-closed test proves zero vault bytes written on the refusal.

Existing setup and write-path tests remain green: full backend suite 1232 passed, frontend 580 passed | 6 skipped, app JS suites 160 passed; write-path tests that model the pre-gate contract were seeded through the real /day-setup route or an explicit day_setup_confirmed fixture so they exercise the write path under the new contract.

changes.behavior: Add DAY_SETUP_CONFIRMED_KEY constant, day_setup_confirmed: False in RUNSTATE_DEFAULTS, and is_day_setup_confirmed(vault_root, valid_date) -> bool (strict is True check; missing/unparseable note -> False; pre-change note without the key fails closed).

Add _require_day_setup route helper (409 + actionable detail). POST /day-setup writes updates[DAY_SETUP_CONFIRMED_KEY] = True in the same locked RMW and returns day_setup_confirmed: True. /plan-inputs returns top-level day_setup_confirmed. _run_live_commit and post_runtime_action/post_runtime_action_undo call _require_day_setup before any client or write work.

projectDaySetup now takes an explicit confirmed boolean (from wire.day_setup_confirmed === true in projectPlanInputs); the any-key heuristic and its comment are removed. projectPlanInputs passes wire.day_setup_confirmed === true.

Add day_setup_confirmed to all 9 plan-inputs fixtures and day-setup-response.json (true for fixtures with non-empty day_setup that model a saved setup; false for plan-inputs.json and plan-inputs-allotment-omitted.json with day_setup: {}).

Update projectDaySetup call sites to pass the flag; add 4 FEEDBACK-24 tests: echoed skeleton keys without the flag stay unconfirmed, the explicit flag drives confirmed, skeleton echo via projectPlanInputs is NOT confirmed, explicit flag confirms an empty echo.

New: TestConfirmationSource (fresh/skeleton/drop/ledger/billed/sequence-side-effect/legacy notes never confirm; scoped to planning day; only /day-setup POST confirms; /plan-inputs exposes the flag) and TestWritePathFailClosed (live commit 409 + zero writes without setup, 200 after setup; runtime-actions apply and undo 409 without setup).
TestLiveCommit three tests seed Day Setup through the real POST /day-setup (frozen to the same date) before the live commit.
TestWritableCalendarPrecondition._post_live seeds Day Setup via POST /day-setup so the calendar-writability precondition stays the tested gate.
test_lock_released_on_error_path seeds Day Setup via POST /day-setup so the shadow-state error path under test is reached.
TestCommitHistoryAppend._seed adds day_setup_confirmed: True to the runstate seed.
route_vault fixture seeds day_setup_confirmed: True in the runstate note.
vault fixture writes a runstate note with day_setup_confirmed: True (digest-index resolution tests unaffected).
vault fixture seeds day_setup_confirmed: True in the runstate note.

preserved_semantics: The dated run-state note shape and the skill's round-trip contract are unchanged; day_setup_confirmed is a new JSON key inside the existing fenced body.
Locked RMW (G26) preserved: /day-setup persists the confirmation in the SAME update_runstate call as the setup fields — no extra write, no lost-update window.

/sequence, /adjust, /validate-sequence, /commit?mode=shadow, /gather, /digest, /capacity-preview, and all GET routes are NOT gated (they are not external write paths); existing /sequence and shadow tests pass untouched.
Frontend store semantics unchanged: SETUP_SAVED still sets confirmed: true on the user's explicit save; INPUTS_LOADED now carries the server's flag instead of the key-presence heuristic.
Contract fixtures updated in lockstep with the server contract (flag is additive; no removed field).

residual_limitations: /sequence and /commit?mode=shadow remain ungated server-side (they are not external write paths; the frontend flag keeps the wizard on setup, and a direct client could still propose/预览 over an unconfirmed day — tracked as follow-up if the cockpit wants a billed-call gate there).

The gate uses HTTP 409 with an actionable detail string; the SPA's api adapter surfaces it as a request failure rather than a dedicated wizard redirect (the wizard normally prevents reaching the write paths).
Legacy app/static wizard (wizard_logic.js/ui_kit.js) is untouched: its non-blocking 'Day Setup not confirmed yet' notice remains, but the SPA is the active surface and is fully flag-driven.
